# Right Time, Right Order

Version 0.12.2 makes the card read dates correctly from feedparser 1.4.0, keeps entries without a date from scrambling the order, and fixes two smaller display problems.

## Dates and order

- **Times, the NEW pill and the sort order are right in any time zone.** feedparser's default date format names no time zone, and the card read such a date as the browser's local time, so everything was off by the browser's UTC offset. feedparser 1.4.0 adds `published_iso` and `updated_iso` (ISO 8601 with the UTC offset) next to each date, and the card now prefers those for the shown time, the sort order, the NEW pill and the channel date. A custom `date_format` no longer hides the date either.
- **Entries without a date go to the end.** An entry the card could not date used to make the sort inconsistent, so the order depended on the order of your entities. Undated entries now stay at the end in their original order, and dated ones are sorted newest first.

## Fixes

- **`description_attribute: content` shows the full text.** feedparser exposes `content` as a list of objects rather than a string, and the card ignored it and fell back to the summary. The text of such a list is now joined and shown, sanitized like any other body. An empty list still falls back to the summary.
- **A broken item image is hidden.** An image that failed to load kept its box and showed its alt text because a style rule outranked the one that hides it. It is hidden now.

## Upgrading

Nothing to change in your card configuration. For correct times, update the feedparser integration to 1.4.0 as well. With an older feedparser the card falls back to the formatted `published`/`updated` text, exactly as in 0.12.1: with the default date format the times are read as the browser's local time and so are off by its UTC offset, and a custom `date_format` the browser cannot parse shows no date and sorts last. A `date_format` that includes the zone, for example `%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S %Z`, avoids this until you update. The two display fixes and the `content` fix need no feedparser update.
